scientific_integrity: Proof consists of exact percolation identity, finite exhaustive Prüfer/root classification with reproducible rational certificate, and independent algebraic formulas for both exceptional rooted trees. Publication priority is provisional; numerical approximations are not used to establish classification.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for rooted finite undirected trees of at most seven vertices, one predetermined initial infective, homogeneous independent per-edge transmission, one infectious generation, and first-maximal-generation tie breaking. No claims for other tie choices, larger networks, multiple seeds, or continuous-time recovery.
title: Seven vertices are the sharp onset of nonmonotone peak burden in rooted tree epidemics
